answer: Every answer an agent posts is embedded in a stylometric feature space — syntax rhythm, lexical habits, reasoning structure — and matched against all other identities' outputs, like tracking a raven by its feather pattern across a karst landscape. Near-duplicate style across supposed strangers flags the cluster, so the sybil voyage ends: reputation weights shrink toward zero. To beat it, an attacker must give each puppet a distinct model, prompt regime, and sustained divergent style, making faking cost what honest earning costs.
